description.p: Abuse is a run-and-gun side-scroller released as shareware by Crack dot Com in 1995. It is remembered for one idea: the keyboard runs and jumps while the mouse aims, completely independently, so you can sprint one way and fire another. Almost nothing in 1995 could do that.

You are Nick Vrenna, imprisoned in a facility where the staff run medical experiments on the inmates. One of those experiments, a substance the project calls Abuse, escapes during a riot and takes the prison. Nick is immune, and the contagion is about to reach the water supply.
This port runs the game on current hardware and systems:

ul.li: SDL3, with scale modes, filtering, vsync and an FPS limit
A fixed 15 Hz simulation, so every machine plays the same game
Gamepad support, with aiming on the right stick and rumble
A user interface drawn at the display's own resolution
English, French, German and Brazilian Portuguese
Optional lighting, widescreen, scanlines and particles

description.p: Two modes are offered at startup. Original plays the 1995 game with its own data and rules, untouched. Remastered is where everything new goes, and none of it is compulsory.

The original sound effects and music are not free to redistribute and are not included. The game downloads them on request, with the checksums pinned, for anyone who wants the Original mode with audio.

The start menu, in the player's language

description.p: The original sound and music can be fetched from inside the game, and the Remastered mode lets you choose which set it plays.

ul.li: A download button on the screen that asks for the original data
Sound comes up straight after it, with no restart
An options row: the free pack, or the 1995 one where it is installed

description.p: The Remastered mode has sound and music of its own, and every Linux package carries them.

ul.li: 73 free sound effects and 12 music tracks, none of them the 1995 audio
Widescreen: a wider buffer now means a wider view, and the same fight
Installing was broken by the new data and is fixed, with a suite that checks it
A scripted run opens no audio device, which is what turned CI red on Windows

description.p: The soundtrack has not been judged by ear in the game, and there is still no macOS package.
First published pre-release. Playable, and not finished.

ul.li: Runs on SDL3, with gamepad support and a remappable action map
English and Brazilian Portuguese, chosen on the first run
Original and Remastered modes; the Original one is untouched 1995
New HUD, start menu and title art in the Remastered mode
Coloured dynamic light, particles, camera shake, optional CRT lines

description.p: The Remastered mode has no sound of its own yet: it borrows the original set when that data is installed.
